The pathway leads to Thrombopoietin, a key hormone involved in blood cell production, suggesting that the compound may exert its effects through a mechanism that involves the regulation of Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP, which in turn affects Thrombopoietin levels. The evidence supports a plausible mechanism where the compound influences the activity of the phosphatase, leading to changes in Thrombopoietin production.
